name: craft-ops
comment: WP-2.5. The craft op: CraftingManager.findMatchingRecipe over a fresh 3x3 (9 entries) or 2x2 (4 entries) InventoryCrafting, entry i in slot i (row-major). t=0: a stone floor and a player (the op needs none; the rng_state dump makes the fixture seed-sensitive). t=1, in order: planks from a log in a 2x2 grid; planks from a birch log (damage 2: a Block ingredient matches any damage) in the 3x3 centre; sticks from planks in the right column (the 1x2 pattern at offset x=2, y=1); a wooden pickaxe; an axe with the pattern mirrored ("XX","#X","# ", matched by the mirrored pass); a bow mirrored; an iron sword in the middle column; mirrored wooden stairs; rose red from a rose (shapeless); blue wool from lapis and white wool (shapeless, dye first); pink from bone meal in the last slot and rose red in the first (shapeless, order free); magenta from lapis, rose red and pink (3 ingredients); magenta from lapis, rose red, rose red and bone meal (4 ingredients); a torch from charcoal (coal damage 1, an ItemStack ingredient); a cake (milk buckets, sugar, egg, wheat); a gold block from nine ingots of any stack size and nine ingots back from it; nine cocoa beans (damage 3) where the lapis block wants damage 4 (null); a chest from planks of damage 1; cobblestone slabs (damage 3); a wrong grid (stick beside cobblestone: null); a 2x2 of cobblestone (null); white wool with a red dye in a 2x2 grid (red wool). t=2: rng_state.
